title: FIPS gate missing: wolfssl aes_gcm update
description: wolfssl_aes_gcm_update() at src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_aes_gcm.c:320 is a gated callback but contains no fips_gate() call. First executable statement at line 329 is an argument check, not the gate. Trigger: user calls write() on an AES-GCM session while wolfCrypt FIPS boundary is degraded. Outcome: GCM buffering proceeds without FIPS status check — FIPS compliance violation.
close_reason: Added wolfssl_fips_gate() as first statement in update() callbacks per FIPS 140-3 requirement
